text:
clare_marketing: Quick heads-up — MistralBio signed off to be our launch spotlight. Need to lock quotes, legal clearance, and a webinar slot. Interview is scheduled for Wed 3:00pm PT. Legal wants final quote wording by EOD Tue. Who can own quote curation and approvals?
caleb_content: I can pull quotes. Will drop 3 options into the doc by EOD today. Linking draft here: https://docs.google.com/draft/mistral-launch (private share)
caleb_content: Candidate quote A (raw):
```\"Redwood reduced our tail latency by 4x and cut token spend by ~38% — better UX and much lower cost.\"```
amy_legal: Thanks — a few legal asks:
- Please replace informal approximations ("~38%") with precise phrasing or spell out "approximately 38%".
- Remove subjective claim "better UX" unless the customer signs off on that language.
- Need the signed quote approval email from the customer (we require explicit consent for attribution).
I can review redlines if you @me with the doc link.
caleb_content: Got it, will update to include two sanitized variants and the original for reference. Will also add a short consent checkbox language for the customer.
sylvie_sales: For the webinar: if this becomes a co-presented customer webinar, route all demo/SQL leads to Sales Ops -> Sylvie + AE team (sf campaign: MISTRAL_LAUNCH). Can we gate the registration form with a question to flag purchase intent?
jamal_prod: Also flag for accuracy — I need to confirm the bench numbers used for the "4x latency" and "38% cost" claims. Quick bench snapshot we used last run: 
```
model: redwood-v1-medium
hw: 1xA100-40GB
seq: 1024
latency p95: 85ms -> after opt: 21ms (4.0x)
cost per token estimate: $0.00012 -> $0.000074 (~38% reduction)
```
jamal_prod: If we publish those, we should include the test harness note and a short caveat.
amy_legal: Thanks Jamal — include the test harness link and the exact dates the bench was run. Will still need written customer approval for the exact wording.
caleb_content: Draft consent email for the customer (paste to doc):
"Hi [Name], thanks again for working with us. We'd love to feature a short quote from you in our launch blog and webinar. Please reply to confirm the following quote (or provide edits):

\"Redwood reduced our tail latency by 4x and reduced token costs by approximately 38% in our tests.\"

By replying 'I approve' you consent to this quote being used in Redwood marketing materials and webinar promotion. If you'd like edits, please reply with suggested wording.
Thanks,
Caleb / Redwood Marketing"
amy_legal: That template is good — please add one line about the timing of the quote usage (embargo/publish window) and a contact for takedowns.
clare_marketing: Proposed timeline:
- Today (Mon): Caleb -> 3 curated quote options in doc + consent email draft.
- Tue EOD: Legal redlines returned to doc.
- Wed 10:00am PT: Legal final signoff / customer approval check.
- Wed 3:00pm PT: Interview with customer (recorded).
- Thu AM: Publish embargoed blog + webinar registration live.
Please call out any blockers ASAP. :thumbsup:
caleb_content: Assigning tasks in the doc and pinging the customer now. I'll also add the SF campaign tag for Sylvie.
sylvie_sales: Perfect — I'll spin up the SF campaign and draft the registration gating question. Will share the campaign id once ready.
calendar-bot: Event created: "MistralBio Interview" Wed 3:00pm PT (organizer: clare_marketing). Invitees: caleb_content, jamal_prod, amy_legal, sylvie_sales, [Mistral contact].
clare_marketing: Great team — thanks. Amy, please flag any legal hard stops here by EOD so we can rearrange.
amy_legal: Will do — reading the doc now, should have redlines by 8pm PT.
caleb_content: Thanks everyone — ping once legal posts redlines and once customer signs the approval (copy to amy_legal).
clare_marketing: Closing loop later today with a short checklist in the doc. If anyone needs to reassign, DM me.
